verdict.rationale: This story describes an in-app quick-navigation/search UI feature (jumping to items by short name), which is a product-usability axis for end users of a project-management/feedback tool, not something evidenced or expected as a distinct 'developer onboarding' capability in this evidence pack; the pack only covers SDK integration, MCP/LLM connectivity, and feedback capture, none of which relate to a short-name jump/search feature.
